biological_reference.closest_mechanism: cerebellar / efference-copy forward model predicting the sensory consequence of the specific issued command (Wolpert, Miall & Kawato 1998; the Frith/Shergill comparator behind SD-031)
dependencies: a sensory representation not temporally smeared below the action timescale (SD-008 alpha_world >= 0.9)
biological_reference.divergence: The hinge max(0, m - ||f(z,a) - f(z,a_cf)||) is scale-unaware and direction-agnostic: it rewards separating ANY two commands by m, including pairs whose true consequences are identical (wall bumps) or smaller than m. At alpha 0.9 the OFF head already separates actions by 0.017-0.024 L2 against a transition L2 of 0.021-0.024, so m >= 0.05 imposes 2-25x the physical separation, and the measured reconstruction loss follows. A biological forward model separates commands only as far as the world does.
